verdict.rationale: A hands-on probe found a real robots.txt at direct.sos.state.tx.us/robots.txt (HTTP 200). It names specific agents (GPTBot, ChatGPT-User, OAI-SearchBot, Googlebot) and disallows them, so an agent can tell what it may read before fetching. The policy is restrictive, but the story only asks that a real robots.txt be published, and it is. Missing for 10: evidence of a robots.txt on the main www.sos.state.tx.us host, first-party documentation of the crawl/agent access policy.
